description: Get recent earthquakes in and around Turkey from the Kandilli Observatory (KOERI) official feed, refreshed every 5 minutes. Returns magnitude, depth (km), coordinates, location name and timestamp (Istanbul time) for each event, newest first. Filters: 'hours' = lookback window (default 24, max 168 = 7 days), 'min_magnitude' = minimum magnitude (e.g. 3 to skip micro-quakes), 'city' = substring match on the location name (e.g. 'izmir', 'balikesir'), 'limit' = max results (default 20, max 100). Use this for 'was there an earthquake in Turkey today?', 'deprem son dakika', 'earthquakes near Izmir this week'. For just the single most recent event, use get_latest_earthquake instead.

city.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the location name, e.g. 'izmir', 'balikesir', 'mugla'. Use ASCII (no Turkish characters).

hours.description: Lookback window in hours. Default 24, max 168 (7 days).

limit.description: Maximum number of earthquakes to return. Default 20, max 100.

min_magnitude.description: Only return quakes at or above this magnitude. Default 0 (all).

name: get_earthquakes
title: Recent Earthquakes in Turkey
